scale.meaning: Subjective design judgment, not an objective certification or measured usability score.

heuristics.label: Match between system and real world

settings.scope: aggregate only; no per-view before scores were recorded

requests.scope: aggregate only; affected rows are separately paired

identity.verdict: Confirmed authored Lumina identity. Preserve the paper/ink/gold palette, serif media hierarchy, restrained standard controls, and capability-preserving flows.
identity.change_policy: Fix verified geometry, clarity, accessibility, and recovery defects without genericizing the product or removing supported controls.

manual_vs_detector.manual: Nielsen scores come from screenshot, source, and focused interaction review. Root and Requests Assessment A were recorded before detector review; media Assessment A was explicitly detector-isolated.
manual_vs_detector.detector: Ten signals total: nine false positives and one confirmed width transition. The confirmed player volume width transition was removed and its hover/focus access is covered by regression evidence. Detector output did not set or modify Nielsen scores.

holistic_assessment.method: Single manual app-level judgment; explicitly not the mean of per-view rows, an objective certification, or measured task completion.
holistic_assessment.change: Confirmed consistency, recognition, and minimalist presentation fixes; Help remains 2/4.

watch_completion.header_geometry: Paired calibration included for populated, empty-season, and failure states (27→34, 23→35, 18→36).
watch_completion.phone_tabs: All five labels are fully visible at 390px in the final wrap layout; generic Watch minimalism changed 2→3 and total 32→33.
watch_completion.validation: 17 focused Playwright checks plus timestamp/source unit coverage passed in the producing packet.

global_limitations: Scores are subjective design judgments on a 0–4 scale, not objective certification, task-completion measurement, or production telemetry.
Most evidence is deterministic synthetic capture at 1440×900 and 390×844 in light and dark themes; actual household media, hosts, credentials, and private names were not used.
The audit covers reviewed views and states, not every combinatorial loading, empty, failure, browser, decoder, subtitle, fullscreen, permission, or network condition.
Settings has one evidenced aggregate pre-fix baseline (28/40) but no per-view pre-fix scores; those before fields remain null.
Unchanged Root and Requests rows carry their formal baseline forward because their after packets identify no material change; only explicitly rescored rows contain after_scores.
A controllable live browser was unavailable for parts of the independent review, so synthetic fixtures and source/test evidence are identified rather than presented as production observation.
coverage_gaps: Other specialized modal variants listed in the inventory
empty, loading, failure, and open action-menu variants for newly captured Shows, Anime, YouTube Videos, and Recordings lenses
empty, restricted, slow-loading, unreachable, follow-error, and channel-settings modal states for Live, Shorts, Playlists, and In your library
validation failure, save conflict, destructive confirmation, provider-search result, and unsaved-navigation dialog states
hardware-decoder failures, native-HLS behavior, real subtitle tracks, and browser fullscreen variations
Uncaptured loading and error combinations are unreviewed
